    StartersHarryhausen's sushi rollsSalmon, avocado and cucumber rolled in nori, with soy and pickled gingerHow to make it300g sushi rice3 tbsp rice vinegar1 tbsp caster sugar4 nori sheets200g sashimi salmon1 avocado1 Lebanese cucumbersoy sauce, to servepickled ginger, to serveRinse and cook the rice, then season with the vinegar and sugar and cool.Slice the salmon, avocado and cucumber into strips.Spread rice over the nori, lay the fillings along each and roll tight.Slice with a wet knife and serve with soy and pickled ginger.Harryhausen's vegetable gyozaPan-fried cabbage and mushroom gyoza with a soy and rice vinegar dipping sauceHow to make it250g Chinese cabbage, finely shredded150g shiitake mushrooms, finely chopped3 spring onions, sliced1 tbsp ginger, grated2 garlic cloves, crushed3 tbsp soy sauce2 tsp sesame oil24 round gyoza wrappers2 tbsp vegetable oil2 tbsp rice vinegarSalt the cabbage, leave 10 minutes, then squeeze out the water.Mix the cabbage, mushrooms, spring onions, ginger, garlic, 1 tbsp soy sauce and the sesame oil.Put a teaspoon of filling on each wrapper, wet the edge and pleat it closed.Fry the gyoza flat side down in the oil for 2 minutes, add 80ml water, cover and steam 4 minutes, then uncover until crisp again.Mix the rest of the soy sauce with the rice vinegar for dipping.Agedashi tofu in dashi brothMike's date with Celia, booth for two, Googly Bear.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsTeriyaki chickenGrilled chicken thighs in a sticky teriyaki glaze, jasmine rice, bok choyHow to make it1kg chicken thighs60ml soy sauce60ml honey60ml chicken stock2 tbsp caster sugar300g jasmine rice1 bunch bok choyMix the soy, honey, chicken stock and sugar and marinate the chicken.Marinate in the fridge.Grill the chicken until charred and cooked through.Reduce the marinade to a glaze and brush over. Cook the rice and steam the bok choy.Monstropolis miso ramenDinner after a shift on the scare floorHow to make itAs written, serves 4Ramen noodles in a rich miso and chicken broth with sticky soy pork belly, a jammy soy egg, corn, greens and chilli oil.Roast 600g pork belly at 160°C for 2 hours, then slice and glaze with 2 tbsp soy and 1 tbsp honey in a hot pan.Boil 4 eggs 6.5 minutes, peel and soak in 60ml soy with 60ml water.Heat 1.5L chicken stock with 3 tbsp white miso and 1 tbsp soy.Cook 400g ramen noodles.Build bowls with noodles, broth, pork, halved eggs, 200g corn, blanched bok choy, spring onion and chilli oil.SweetsBoo's raspberry jam thumbprint cookiesButtery cookies with a thumbprint of raspberry jamHow to make it125g soft butter80g caster sugar1 egg yolk1/2 tsp vanilla extract180g plain flour2 tbsp raspberry jam1 tbsp icing sugarBeat the butter and sugar until pale, add the yolk and vanilla, then mix in the flour.Roll into 20 balls, place on a lined tray and press a deep hole in each. Fill with jam.Bake at 180°C.Cool on the tray and dust with icing sugar.Yeti's lemon snow conesShaved ice with homemade lemon syrup, eat it fastHow to make it1kg ice3 lemons150g caster sugar150ml waterSimmer the sugar, water, lemon juice and zest.Chill the syrup.Crush or shave the ice, pack into four cups and pour the syrup over. Eat fast before it melts.DrinksScream canister pineapple slushiePineapple, mango and lemon blended with ice, topped with fizzy lemon sherbetHow to make it600ml pineapple juice1 mango2 lemons4 cups ice1 tsp lemon sherbetChop the mango and juice the lemons.Blend the pineapple juice, mango, lemon juice and ice until thick and slushy.Pour into four clear glasses and sprinkle sherbet over each so it fizzes. Serve straight away with spoon straws.
